name: Unorthodox Infusion
body:
Unorthodox Infusion (Su)
Source Heroes of Golarion pg. 30
You learn to master an infusion beyond those that normally apply to the elements in which you specialize. You learn a new infusion of your choice, regardless of that infusion’s associated blasts. You can apply the chosen infusion to any blasts you are capable of using, even if they are not one of that infusion’s associated blasts. You must be at least 3rd tier to select this path ability.
